utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Case number IT-96-21-Abis, the Prosecutor versus Zdravko Mucic, Hazim Delic, and Esad Landzo. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Appearances. Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Thank you. Norman Farrell and Mr. Anthony Carmona for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: For Mr. Delic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KUZMANOVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Tomislav Kuzmanovic on behalf of Mr. Zdravko Mucic. Mr. Morrison is in trial this week.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Glad you were able to make it. I gather you had some problems. For Mr. Mucic.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please, microphone.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARABDIC
utterances.text: For Hazim Delic. With me is my colleague Thomas Moran from Houston.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Karabdic. And for Mr. Landzo.

utterances.speaker: MS. SINATRA
utterances.text: Good afternoon, for Mr. Landzo, I'm Cynthia Sinatra and along with me is my esteemed counsel Mr. Murphy.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, this is a Status Conference which we are obliged to hold in accordance to the Rules, so many days having passed since the last time the matter was in Court. Is there anything the Prosecution seeks to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. FARRELL
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Any matters under Rule 65 bis that the accused wish to raise? Mr. Kuzmanovic?

utterances.speaker: MR. KUZMANOVIC
utterances.text: Nothing today, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Mr. Karabdic?

utterances.speaker: MR. MORAN
utterances.text: Nothing, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Ms. Sinatra.

utterances.speaker: MS. SINATRA
utterances.text: Nothing, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Yes, I rather gathered from inquiries made when we were arranging the date that that may be the result. But we're very grateful for you having coming. It is very important that you have some contact with your clients face-to-face. It seems them at least understanding that people are representing them still. You are no doubt all thinking you would like to ask when the judgement will be delivered. There is a draft in existence but it hasn't been completed. I have to say to you only as by way of some explanation, since the number of Trial Chambers increased from three to six the work has actually more than doubled in the Appeals Chamber, and we regret the time that has it has taken. However, there were a number of very important issues raised which we have to deal with and deal with them with some care, at least to avoid them arising again, but we are hopeful to be getting it out within a reasonable time. I think I can assure you there will be no further Status Conferences. Well, with that, thank you very much for coming, and we'll now adjourn.
